about: GTA 6 'It has X, shown' (Delta, slug gta-furries): an in-game TV ad from the 'Anti-Furry Association' says furry activity is illegal in Leonida and to report it (Dexerto, PinkNews, EarlyGame, Nov 18-19 2026). Reviewers (CNET's David Lumb via Dexerto/PinkNews; GQ via Dexerto) met a man in a fox suit under a police helicopter; you can break the blockade and help the furries escape to a compound. Creator clips from @nerpah's run (rule 10, facecam cropped): the van meet-up, the hideout gun wall, the reward prompt GUN / CASH ($15,000). The reward is only claimed as shown in that player's run. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.text: In GTA 6, being a furry is illegal.
lines.say: In G T A six, being a furry is illegal.

lines.text: An in-game TV ad says: report any furry activity.
So what happens when the cops find one?
Reviewers met a furry, under a police helicopter.
Break the blockade, and you can help them escape.
Their hideout? A whole wall of guns.
In this player's run, the reward: a gun, or $15,000.
lines.say: In this player's run, the reward: a gun, or fifteen thousand dollars.

lines.text: Gun or cash? Which one are you taking?
